short_description: Customizable private walking tours in Chicago tailored to groups of any size and interest.
group_size: Examples given from small groups up to 120 guests
description: Inside Chicago Walking Tours offers fully customizable private walking tours designed around each group's interests, from architecture and jazz history to gangster-era Route 66 themes. No two private tours are the same: examples range from intimate day-long experiences for couples to one-hour walks for conference attendees and large corporate or family outings. Guides blend favorite downtown highlights and public route options into tailored itineraries, with pricing that decreases per person for larger groups.

what_is_included_items.value: Customized private tour content tailored to client interests
Guided walking tour led by Inside Chicago Walking Tours staff
Adaptation of content from public tour routes for private use

highlights:
* Fully customizable itineraries based on group interests
* Options ranging from brief "power hour" tours to day-long private experiences
* Suitable for a wide range of group types including families, corporate groups, conferences, and special-interest themes
check_in_details: Contact Hillary to get started or for more information: call 312-799-0164.
disclaimers: Private tours can be built around public tour routes or combined elements from multiple routes. Examples describe past group sizes and themes but do not guarantee availability of identical experiences.
